rows.en: <operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>The higher-ups are hopeless. Underestimating the enemy is exactly why we're in this mess.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>Still, this move came too fast. It was probably planned carefully in advance.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>But once they've gained a means to freely space-leap, this was bound to happen.
rows.notes: 'space-leap' per locked encyclopedia term for kuukan choyaku (distinct from 'spatial transfer').

rows.en: <operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>You've got no direct stake in this, so there's no reason you have to help... but I'm asking for your cooperation here.
rows.notes: Speaker id 10030 resolves to Light Newman; the blunt register ('antatachi', sentence-final 'wa') differs from Light's usual diligent tone elsewhere, but the tag is kept per brief.

rows.en: <operator(23030,2)><speed(2)>You lot have helped us out plenty too. Call it even.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>That's right. We're all bound to the same fate now.
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>That's right! With a lineup like this, nothing to be afraid of!
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>Good spirits are one thing, but you never know what a battle will bring. Be careful out there.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>... Is <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> on your mind?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah. Leaving him alone seems dangerous too.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>I get that he's on your mind, but let's focus on the fight ahead.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Of course, I know that.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>Compared to when we started, <color(4)>Barrel<ce()>'s gotten a lot more dependable.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Huh? T-that's not...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>That's right. His results so far prove it.
<operator(1060,2)><speed(2)>His performance has improved by leaps and bounds, after all.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Is that so?
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()> must have had the aptitude for piloting. And he was a good match for the machine too.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>I'm glad to hear you say that.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Enough chit-chat already! Let me deploy already!
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Hey, don't rush it.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>If not now, then when?!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>He's really worked up.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>That's simply how he gets himself fired up.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>It's not a way I can get used to... but I understand how he feels.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Hey, were the Gundams from that other world originally built for space combat too?
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>That's right. <color(4)>GX<ce()> was built as the trump card to defend Earth from the colony forces.
rows.notes: 'GX' kept as the abbreviated in-line form of the locked 'Gundam X'; no prior corpus precedent for the shorthand, flagged.

rows.en: <operator(10020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Leopard<ce()> and <color(4)>Airmaster<ce()> too?
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>Seems that way. By the time we got hold of them, they'd already been modified for ground use, though.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>A hired Vulture heading up into space - couldn't imagine that back in our world.
rows.notes: 'Vulture' = locked freelance mobile-suit-rider role term per character_names_021.

rows.en: <operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>So we've got an aptitude for space combat, huh. All right, let's give it our all!
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>... don't push yourself... Come back safe...
<operator(17010,2)><speed(2)>No worries! With <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> here, I'm unbeatable!
<operator(23010,2)><speed(2)>All right! Let's do this!
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>Getting fired up is fine, but don't go and screw up trying too hard.
<operator(23010,2)><speed(2)>I know, but... as a guy, not getting fired up in a situation like this would be weird, right... <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>?
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>Fired up...?
rows.notes: Eureka takes Renton's 'fired up' (moeru) literally, matching her blunt/distant personality per glossary.

rows.en: <operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Ah, right... never mind if you don't get it. Yeah...
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Eureka<ce()>, it's an environment you're not used to. Don't push yourself.
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>Yeah.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Well, I'm not used to this place either.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Once we get through this, it's goodbye to space, huh.
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Missing solid ground, <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Well, a little... What about you?
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Yeah, I miss it. No chance for the ladies to dress up out here.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>That's a pretty impure reason to have, isn't it?
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Is <color(4)>Macross<ce()> really that amazing?
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>It's a massive ship over 1,200 meters long, with a whole city built inside.
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>And that <color(4)>Macross<ce()> is what gave rise to the superstar idol, <color(4)>Lynn Minmay<ce()>.
rows.notes: 'Lynn Minmay' per locked encyclopedia_021_a spelling (Macross wiki).

rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>It was <color(4)>Lynn Minmay<ce()>'s song that defeated <color(5)>Boddole Zer<ce()> and ended the war three years ago, right?
rows.notes: 'Boddole Zer' per locked encyclopedia spelling. 'the war three years ago' kept casual/lowercase; source does not use the encyclopedia's proper title here.

rows.en: <operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>But turning even that into a military weapon... the enemy sure seems desperate.
